job_description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Optical Simulation Engineer to develop and apply advanced computational tools that model the complex optical and multiphysics behavior of our high-energy laser systems. In this role, you will build high-fidelity digital models that directly inform system architecture, component design, and experimental validation for next-generation fusion laser drivers. Your work will be foundational to our digital twin environment — enabling predictive optimization, accelerating design cycles, reducing experimental risk, and helping transform advanced laser physics into reliable, scalable energy infrastructure. What you’ll do Multiphysics Simulation Development: Design, build, and validate integrated optical and multiphysics simulation frameworks that couple laser amplification, optical propagation, thermal, mechanical, and fluid effects into predictive system models. Laser System Modeling: Model complex amplifier architectures, gain media, pump geometries, and thermal management schemes to predict efficiency, beam quality, optical distortions, and stability under high-average-power operation. Digital Twin Enablement: Develop and maintain the simulation backbone of Focused Energy’s digital twin environment, enabling system-level optimization, trade studies, and performance forecasting. Model Validation & Uncertainty Analysis: Integrate experimental data with simulation outputs, perform sensitivity and uncertainty analyses, and continuously refine models to improve predictive accuracy and decision confidence. Cross-Functional Design Support: Partner closely with optical engineers, laser physicists, and experimental teams to ensure alignment between models, prototypes, and performance targets — and to guide design iteration. Optimization & Acceleration: Implement surrogate models, reduced-order techniques, and optimization workflows to accelerate simulations and support large-scale design space exploration. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Produce high-quality technical documentation, model descriptions, and internal tools that are usable, maintainable, and trusted across the organization. Who you are Master’s or Ph.D. in optics, computational physics, applied mathematics, or a related field — or equivalent experience building physics-based simulation tools in complex R&D environments. Deep understanding of laser and optical systems, including propagation, polarization, scattering, spectral effects, and their interaction with thermal and mechanical phenomena. Proven experience developing multiphysics or digital twin models for complex physical systems and using them to drive engineering or scientific decisions. Proficiency with multiphysics and optical tools (e.g., COMSOL, ANSYS, Zemax, FRED, CodeV) and strong programming skills (Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar) with version control (Git). You approach modeling as a scientific discipline — validating assumptions, quantifying uncertainty, and continuously improving fidelity and usefulness. Comfortable working across disciplines and translating complex simulation results into actionable insights for experimental and design teams. Preferred: Experience with system modeling tools (Simulink, Modelica, Simcenter, Twin Builder) and integrated digital engineering workflows. Preferred: Familiarity with HPC environments, parallel computing (MPI, CUDA), and automation pipelines for large-scale simulation and optimization. Preferred: Hands-on exposure to laser systems or optomechanical hardware and an appreciation for how real-world behavior informs and constrains models. job_description: Social Media & Content Strategist (Firearms & Tactical) You should know: Location: On-Site in North Dallas, TX and/or Farmers Branch, TX Position Type : Full-Time, Direct Hire Compensation: Up to $80K Citizenship Requirements: U.S. Citizens and Green Card Holders only Why this role matters: We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead our digital presence. This isn't a role for a casual hobbyist or a generalist agency; we need a Subject Matter Expert (SME) who lives and breathes the industry. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between high-level technical specs and compelling brand narratives, ensuring our voice is respected by professionals and enthusiasts alike. What you'll do everyday: Narrative Ownership: Develop and execute social media strategies that speak directly to specific audience segments, from first-time buyers to competitive shooters and tactical professionals and sporting enthusiasts. Technical Content Creation: Translate complex firearm specifications and accessory applications into digestible, high-engagement content without losing technical accuracy. Campaign Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of branded social media campaigns, ensuring consistent ROI and community growth across all platforms. Community Authority: Act as the "voice of the brand," engaging in high-level technical discussions and maintaining brand integrity in a highly scrutinized industry. Platform Navigation: Expertly manage content distribution within the shifting landscape of social media community standards related to regulated goods. What you bring: Intermediate to Advanced Firearms Knowledge: You must possess a deep understanding of firearm platforms (AR, bolt-action, handgun), optics, ballistics, and tactical gear. You should be comfortable discussing "use-case" scenarios and technical applications with confidence. You must be able to effectively market specific products to nuanced target audiences with a compelling and impactful message. Industry Fluency: You understand the nuances of the firearms community. You know the "unwritten rules" of the culture and how to craft narratives that build trust rather than just "moving product." Proven Social Media Track Record: Minimum 3+ years of experience managing official company/branded social media accounts. You know how to read analytics, pivot strategies, and scale a brand’s digital footprint. Strategic Thinking: Experience running paid (where applicable) and organic campaigns that align with broader business objectives and product launches. Bonus if you have: Experience with photography or videography within the tactical space. Active participation in the shooting sports or tactical training community. Knowledge of compliance and legal considerations for firearm-related marketing.

job_description: Who We Are Gravity is powering the decarbonization of industry by helping businesses and their supply chain partners manage and reduce their carbon footprint. Our energy and carbon management platform makes it easy and cost-effective for companies to measure their emissions, implement tangible reduction projects with vetted vendors, and reduce both energy and emissions. We align the incentives and actors in a disconnected landscape to make real emissions reduction happen. Founded by leaders from generational startups, physical operators, and star academics, Gravity is backed by top VCs. On the strength of a differentiated product, we have quickly grown to serve hundreds of customers across the world, from Fortune 500s to global energy majors to leading financial institutions. The Opportunity Gravity seeks tenacious and curious professionals for our Climate Strategy department. This department owns the strategic relationship with our customers – partnering with companies to develop and implement their decarbonization goals. In doing so, you will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to develop our best-in-class energy and carbon management technology. Ideal candidates will have a deep hunger for not only structuring and delivering the climate journeys for large enterprises, but also for understanding and refining what value is in a dynamic market; this job involves more than a traditional Customer Success Manager role. Domain expertise is not required, but an exceptional ability to get up to speed on technical domains is. You’ll have opportunities to develop and implement company stances around cutting-edge climate and energy approaches. As an early member of the team, you will play a transformational role in our company culture while laying the groundwork for Gravity's customer success posture and technical profile for years to come. Qualifications & Skills Relentless enthusiasm for solving problems and clearly communicating complex processes. Comfort working with enterprise customers at all stages of their product journeys, and hunger to refine and deliver real value for important businesses and the climate. Impeccable project management skills. You keep the trains running when the schedules change. Enthusiasm for turning unstructured data into accurate and actionable business intelligence. Autonomy; comfort delivering world-class results in a rapidly evolving environment. Ability to work cross-functionally and contribute to the overall development of a rapidly scaling company. Curiosity. Nice to Have Expertise in corporate decarbonization efforts. Experience working at a startup or other fast-paced organization. Comfort selling or upselling transformative SaaS to enterprise customers. Knowledge of industrial customers' systems, emissions profiles, and/or business needs. Gravity provides Foundational impact at a company transforming industrial sustainability. Competitive salary. Paid health, vision, dental, and life insurance. Meaningful equity. Unlimited PTO. Health & wellness stipend. Paid company travel. Thank you for your interest in Gravity!

Genuine enthusiasm for AI—not as a buzzword, but as a tool you use and a space you follow closely Experience with SEO fundamentals; bonus if you're already thinking about AEO (answer engine optimization) and GEO (generative engine optimization) Based in NYC Nice to Have Experience in proptech, real estate, or operationally complex industries Experience with conference marketing and field events Why This Role Is Different Most product marketing roles are about refining what already exists. If you're excited by blank canvases, by building the thing instead of optimizing the thing, and by working at the intersection of AI and one of America's most essential industries—this is for you.

Interest in renewable energy systems, electric vehicles, datacenter power architectures and/or industrial electrification. job_description: About Hotplate Hotplate exists to enable anyone to start and scale a local food business without a brick and mortar. The traditional brick and mortar restaurant model is broken: it requires six figures in upfront capital and comes with high operating costs. Within their first year, 2/3 of all restaurants and bakeries close. The next wave of food entrepreneurship is emerging. These chefs and bakers run businesses from home, commissary kitchens, or mobile pop-ups. They generate hype and buzz on Instagram and run almost entirely on pre-orders. The result is 50-80% profit margins, over 10x the traditional 5% margin of a brick and mortar. But today’s e-commerce tools weren’t built for this way of selling food. Without Hotplate, chefs and bakers hack together DMs, Google Forms, Square, and Shopify. They spend more time managing logistics than growing their business. We support the top pop ups in the country, many of which are recognized by the New York Times, Infatuation, Eater, etc. and recently crossed 5,000 businesses and $80M paid out on the platform, but we're just getting started. By building the foundational tool for this new model, we have the opportunity to fundamentally change the food industry for the better: increasing the diversity and accessibility of food by making it possible for anyone to start a food business. If you want to read more to make sure Hotplate is a good fit, check out our philosophies on hiring , fundraising , and our values . The role As a full stack engineer at Hotplate, you'll build end-to-end features that will directly impact how thousands of chefs' and bakers' businesses run their businesses. You'll get to stretch across a range of work like building scalable systems & infrastructure to handle ticketmaster-style food drops, Chef-facing features that will provide powerful ways to manage and grow their business, and consumer-facing storefront and buying experiences that delight. This role is best suited for someone who likes to participate in the full process of building features, from supporting on ideation and design to executing features independently. What you will need to be successful Extremely comfortable working full stack A high bar for delivering clean, intuitive, UX experiences A love for designing products and features from scratch Have worked in early to mid-stage startups before, with experience taking projects from 0 to 1 independently Comfortable with our stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node, Express, PostgreSQL, AWS 3+ years of product-focused, full-stack engineering Our philosophy of engineering Hotplate's engineering team is small, and as we scale we want to keep it that way. Every engineer operates in a full stack capacity. Features are owned by individuals, so even though we all have our strengths, each of us pushes code to all layers of the app. We find this increases our velocity, results in better decision-making before and during feature development, and is a forcing function for us to grow as full stack contributors. Our team We are a lean, mission-driven team. We exist to enable the next million chefs and bakers to scale local food businesses outside the brick & mortar model. We operate with high ownership, laser focus on the impact we have for our chefs and bakers, and commitment to take on projects that push us out of our comfort zones. We’re a tight-knit crew. We jam with a daily shared playlist, often hang for team lunch and happy hours, and always have snacks on the table (made by the team or a Hotplate Chef). We love working in a place where we all have a connection, and think it helps us work better as a team. Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents 401(k) retirement plan Unlimited PTO (that people actually take) Parental leave Monthly budget to spend on Hotplate Hotplate is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

job_description: Overview: We are seeking a Design Physicist to study laser–plasma interaction (LPI) and laser propagation physics relevant to Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE). This role focuses on understanding laser absorption, speckle formation, parametric instabilities, and hot-electron generation in laser-generated plasmas, to improve coupling efficiency and predictive modeling of Inertia’s fusion targets. You will work closely with the systems modeling and laser science teams to reconcile the target design and laser architecture for manageable LPI. Primary Responsibilities: Studying speckle formation and beam smoothing in high-powered laser systems. Using simulation tools, such as pF3D, to estimate laser propagation and instability growth for Inertia. Collaborating with LLNL on an Inertia-LLNL contract to model LPI using LLNL simulation capabilities. Designing and analyzing laser–plasma experiments to study energy coupling, instability mitigation, and cross-beam energy transfer, integrating insights into the laser system and target design. Qualifications: Required: PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Nuclear Engineering, or related field. Strong foundation in plasma physics and computational modeling. Background in laser–plasma interaction or inertial confinement fusion research. Experience with simulation tools or programming (Python, C++, or equivalent). Preferred: Familiarity with Maxwell–Vlasov (MV), MVFP, and PIC codes. Strong communication and teamwork skills. job_description: Come join us at Intro Intro is growing our team of amazing people who are on a mission to give everyone access to anyone, empowering each other to create a better world . Intro started in 2022 by first building a tool for the world’s top founders and experts, enabling their audiences from all over the world to be able to access them, jump on a live video call, and get personalized advice. We were (and still are) grateful to see that it was an INSTANT hit. Today, we have over 20k five star ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ reviews, and the founders of Reddit, Zillow, Sweetgreen, DryBar, and 1k+ more all became partners, as well as advocates of our product, company, and mission. We then launched a marketplace, chat, subscriptions, and more, each leading to faster growth. We’re just getting started — the Intro of tomorrow will look very different than the Intro of today. In fact, we’re confident that Intro will become the go-to network for access, knowledge, and…(we can’t say the last part just yet), all over the world. If you’re interested in joining an amazing company that is growing (fast), loved by its users, and deeply cares about quality, we’d love to meet you. Team Hey everyone! it’s Raad, CEO at Intro 👋 Our team is world-class. It’s the best team I’ve ever worked with because everyone here is (1) a good person who cares about the mission (2) they’re functionally great at their craft, and (3) they help each other out! It’s a very no-drama type of place which is what happens when everyone is really good at what they do. In their past careers, people on our team helped create or build major products like QuickBooks Online, Uber Eats, Calm, and more. We love working on BIG problems for a LOT of people and believe that Intro will be the most impactful yet. The Role – Creator in Residence (TikTok & Instagram) We’re building a world-class brand and we’re looking for a Creator in Residence to help us bring it to life on TikTok and Instagram. You’re a natural on camera. You’ve built an audience (your own or someone else’s). You know how to entertain, educate, and engage. And you do it all with taste. Our brand is elevated, inspiring, and rooted in real stories from the world’s top experts and founders. We’re looking for someone who can translate that energy into short-form video that doesn’t just get views—but actually drives excitement and conversion. Here’s what we’re thinking: You’ve built a personal or professional brand on TikTok, Instagram, or Youtube to 20k+ followers You’re great on camera and can also direct or guide others to be You can turn raw ideas into polished video content You know how to make content that aligns with a brand's voice and visual identity You have a solid grasp of the tools of narrative, pacing, and sound design You know how to batch, schedule, and publish short-form video at a high quality and cadence You live and breathe internet culture and you know how to riff on trends Ideal Requirements 1–3 years of experience as a creator or content producer for social media A proven track record of building an engaged following on TikTok, Instagram, or Youtube Strong video editing skills (Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or similar tools) Deep understanding of storytelling and visual pacing for short-form Comfortable in front of the camera and/or directing on-camera talent A strong eye for quality and detail in graphics, sound design, and editing techniques Bonus: experience producing UGC or founder-led content Bonus: you’ve built content that drives conversion, not just likes Bonus: you’ve built content for brands in the startup, tech, or creator economy space Our Investors We’re backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16Z), 776, Alexis Ohanian (founder of Reddit), Tiffany Haddish, Kevin Durant, and a group of world-class investors. Company Values Impress the customer Be successful as a company Be creative, inventive, and scrappy Keep it simple and execute Take a moment to understand others Feedback should make us stronger, not weaker Ideas are important. Execution is 10x more important. Stay grateful Why work with us? On your first day, we’ll do a few exercises to help you identify your life goals. We’ll ask questions like “what do you imagine your life looking like if you achieved all of your goals” and “why are those goals important to you?” Once we identify these, they become our goals and we will work together to help make them a reality. Next, we’ll ask you about things that matter to you in the short term. These could be things like a gym membership, meditation classes, or an allowance to attend concerts. It’s an open ended exercise and we’ll come up with a perks package that makes you feel valued. Please note, we cannot yet buy you a ticket on a SpaceX rocket. It’s been asked! Finally, here are the things you’ll definitely get: competitive salary, equity (you become an owner of the business), health insurance, apple equipment, company trips and events, allowances, flexible vacation days, flexible sick days, recharge day

job_description: About IntusCare IntusCare is the only end-to-end ecosystem built specifically to help Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) programs deliver exceptional care, strengthen financial performance, and stay compliant. IntusCare replaces outdated technology and manual workarounds with purpose-built solutions for care coordination, risk adjustment, population health, and utilization management. We empower teams to take control of their operations and improve outcomes for dual-eligible seniors- some of the most socially vulnerable and clinically complex individuals in the US healthcare system. Role Overview We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of our risk adjustment product. This role is ideal for someone who has experience working on data products in the value-based care space. Our risk adjustment product combines our analytics platform with our medical coding services to surface key financial insights and ensure accurate, compliant coding. In This Role You Will: Partner with design and engineering to shape the next generation of our risk adjustment platform. Engage directly with clients to uncover pain points, surface unmet needs, and translate insights into product improvements. Collaborate across customer success, sales, and engineering to ensure our products meet market demands and stay ahead of regulator requirements. Define clear goals and KPIs to measure impact, inform prioritization, and drive value. Develop high-quality documentation & artifacts to ensure clarity for cross-functional partners and stakeholders Qualifications 5-7 years of experience in product management, with a significant portion in healthcare, preferably in a startup setting. At least 3 years of experience working in Value-Based-Care (VBC) and financial analytics, with demonstrated comfort with CMS risk adjustment. Ability to interface directly with customers and navigate ambiguity across all stages of product development. Comfort collaborating effectively with engineering and design teams. Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and leadership abilities, capable of motivating and guiding teams towards successful product delivery. Proficiency writing SQL queries, including multi-table joins and aggregations. Familiarity with medical claims data is a plus. What We Offer A chance to be a part of a trailblazing team in healthcare technology. Competitive salary and equity package. Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. A collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment. Opportunities for professional growth and development Compensation : The salary range for this role is $160K-$175K. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills and organizational needs. The role will offer equity and possibly bonus. Work location : This is a fully remote role based in the United States. Sponsorship : This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

job_description: What We Do Axe builds AI agents for logistics and supply chain operations. Logistics is a trillion-euro industry still powered by billions of phone calls, emails, and spreadsheets. Axe replaces this manual work with intelligent AI agents - so human teams can focus on high-impact, strategic work. Founded by James McElroy and Dan Quill (exits to Blackstone and Wayflyer), Axe has grown rapidly in its first 7 months. We now operate across Europe and the U.S., partnering with some of the world’s largest logistics providers and backed by top tier EU VC's . You can learn more about our vision in our Manifesto . We’re building a world-class team to create a generational AI company and modernise how the physical economy runs. What You’ll Do Identify, assess, and prioritise new industry verticals for Axe to expand into. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, and define the ideal customer profile for each vertical. Develop tailored go-to-market motions, value propositions, and activation plans. Build frameworks to evaluate new geographic markets and recommend country-level entry strategies. Work with leadership to shape launch plans covering distribution, pricing, compliance, and localisation. Support market activation by coordinating closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product. Source, evaluate, and structure partnerships across technology, distribution, and channel partners. Build business cases, negotiate partnership terms, and define joint go-to-market initiatives. Manage ongoing partner relationships and track performance. Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to ensure aligned and effective GTM execution. Must Have Experience in venture capital, investment banking, strategic consulting, or high-growth startups/scale-ups. Proven ability to evaluate new markets, assess business models, and build data-backed business cases. Experience leading or supporting initiatives in new market entry, vertical expansion, partnerships, or go-to-market planning. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Highly organised and comfortable managing cross-functional workstreams in fast-paced environments. Proactive, self-driven, and able to operate with autonomy in ambiguous situations. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Why join us? Be part of a fast-growing, VC-backed AI company redefining a massive industry. Work directly with experienced founders who have scaled and exited companies before. Huge career growth opportunities as we scale across Europe and the US. High ownership, high impact your work directly shapes customer success. Competitive salary + performance bonuses. Join the early team building Europe’s next AI powerhouse. Key Benefits Stock-options Health Insurance Generous Paid Time Off - work hard and take the time you need Annual company-wide offsite

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies. We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth , powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world. Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital. The Role We’re hiring a Content Marketing Manager to become the voice of Juicebox . This role owns the content that prospects and customers experience outside the product, including blog posts, case studies, videos, SEO content, and more. You’ll work closely with the marketing team and our customers to tell the stories of how companies are using Juicebox to transform their hiring. You Will Own Juicebox’s content strategy and execution Write and publish blog posts, case studies, and SEO content Interview customers and create compelling customer stories Produce additional content formats including videos, guides, and thought leadership Manage and edit work from external writers and contributors, including social media content Identify opportunities for new content initiatives and distribution channels Ensure all published content reflects Juicebox’s voice, brand, and product expertise Help make SEO a major customer acquisition channel You Have 2+ years of B2B content marketing experience (4+ preferred) Strong writing and storytelling ability Experience producing SEO-driven content Familiarity with tools like Semrush, Profound, or similar SEO / AEO platforms Ability to work with external writers and maintain a consistent voice Strong ownership mentality and ability to operate independently Sales, Marketing, and Customer Relations Marketing and Public Relations FullTime

job_description: ジョーシスについて ジョーシスは、「Simplify IT, Empower communities」をミッションに、全世界共通に存在するコーポレートIT部門の構造的な課題を解消するための、グローバルなAIソリューションを提供しています。 2021年9月にサービスをローンチしてから約2年で売上を10倍に伸ばし、海外のユニコーン企業に匹敵するグローバルトップクラスの成長スピードで急拡大しているスタートアップです。国内エンタープライズ企業への導入実績は数百社を超え、開発は米国とインド、グローバルGTMはオーストラリアに拠点を置き、世界40カ国でサービス展開を開始しています。 2023年9月にはシリーズBとして135億円（総額179億円）の大型資金調達を実施しました。この金額は、2023年のAIを除くシリーズA・Bスタートアップにおいて日本1位、米国5位、アジア4位にランクインしており、JOSYSは日本だけでなくグローバルで最も注目されるスタートアップの1社となっています。 ジョーシスは、ラクスル創業者である松本恭攝が第二創業として始めたスタートアップで、創業当初からグローバルな組織構築を行い、今ではアジア・米国・欧州へとチームも大きく拡大しています。国内・海外ともにグローバルトップレベルの優秀なメンバーが続々と集まり、日本発グローバル企業のDAY1を創る、最高にエキサイティングなフェーズを迎えています。 解決する課題 急速に利用が拡大するSaaS・AIアプリにより、世界中のコーポレート部門は複雑な管理業務を求められる状況にあります。また、昨今のサイバーセキュリティインシデントでは、漏洩したIDを用いた攻撃がスタンダードとなっており、エンタープライズを中心により高いレベルでの対策が急務となっています。 一方で、求められる速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これはコロナ禍を経てSaaS利用が増大した背景があり、日本だけでなくグローバルで同時多発的に発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。 そこで求められるのは、AIによってアイデンティティ・SaaS・デバイスの情報を統合的に管理し、リスクを最小化しながら運用を効率化することです。ジョーシスはAI Drivenなマネジメントプラットフォームを通じて、現場のオペレーションまで一貫して支援し、企業のアイデンティティ管理におけるガバナンス向上とセキュリティリスクの最小化に寄与します。 日本発グローバル企業への挑戦 海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。 業務概要 創業2年で急拡大、グローバルトップクラスの成長スピードを続けているJOSYSで、収益の柱となる日本市場において最速の売上成長率を実現し続けることをミッションに、国内のエンタープライズ顧客の開拓と、そこからの圧倒的な売上創出を担っていただきます。 流入してくるリードだけではなく、新規開拓をして頂きます。 バイネームで担当顧客を決め、5社～20社の顧客獲得を設計し営業活動をして頂きます。 業務詳細 営業戦略の策定・立案〜実行 担当業種において最短で売上数億円を達成するための戦略策定〜実行 担当業種における、アカウントプラン・インダストリープランの策定と実行 上記戦略を実現するための、営業戦術を含めたビジネスオペレーションの設計、及び実行 売上の創出 四半期単位での高い売上目標に対し、常に成果をデリバリーする強い営業力とコミットメント 積極的・戦略的な新規顧客の開拓、商談機会の創出を通じたパイプライン生成 担当領域においてDirect Salesとして、エンドユーザーに対する提案・契約獲得 社内リソースを適切に巻き込んだ顧客との関係構築（Cスイート・役員・部長）、及びビジネスチャンスの発見 担当業種における、販売方法論の確立、プロセスの確立、販売ツールの最適化等を通じた売上の増加 必須条件（MUST） BtoB SaaSまたはソフトウェアビジネスにおけるエンタープライズ営業経験3年以上 人間関係構築能力に優れ、テリトリー拡大の実績がある方 ソリューション/バリューセリングの経験がある方 常にノルマを達成し、個人として再現性のある圧倒的な営業成績・実績のある方 優れた口頭および書面でのコミュニケーションスキル・交渉スキル 歓迎条件（WANT） 3年連続、目標達成率が100％を上回った実績を持っている方 エンタープライズ顧客ポートフォリオで、高い事業成長率を実現した成功経験を持っている方 クライアントをナビゲートし、複数の部門および複数のリーダーなどキーとなるクライアントとの関係を構築する能力 部門やチームの垣根を超えた横断的な連携や社内外問わず影響を与えることができる高い適性 顧客組織をしっかりと導き、複数の部門間及び異なるレベルの階層にまたがって連携出来る能力 顧客のビジネスオペレーションにおける改善点を見出し付加価値を提供できる アカウント計画をたてるに際し、リサーチをし、データに基づいた統計的なアプローチを取れること 顧客のシニアレベルの担当者ともテクノロジーに基づいたディスカッションをリードする能力があること チーム全体の成功のための投資をすることができる強い自発性の持ち主 ジョーシス掲載メディア [Josys] Working at Josys job_description: ジョーシスについて ジョーシスは、「Simplify IT, Empower communities」をミッションに、全世界共通に存在するコーポレートIT部門の構造的な課題を解消するための、グローバルなAIソリューションを提供しています。 2021年9月にサービスをローンチしてから約2年で売上を10倍に伸ばし、海外のユニコーン企業に匹敵するグローバルトップクラスの成長スピードで急拡大しているスタートアップです。国内エンタープライズ企業への導入実績は数百社を超え、開発は米国とインド、グローバルGTMはオーストラリアに拠点を置き、世界40カ国でサービス展開を開始しています。 2023年9月にはシリーズBとして135億円（総額179億円）の大型資金調達を実施しました。この金額は、2023年のAIを除くシリーズA・Bスタートアップにおいて日本1位、米国5位、アジア4位にランクインしており、JOSYSは日本だけでなくグローバルで最も注目されるスタートアップの1社となっています。 ジョーシスは、ラクスル創業者である松本恭攝が第二創業として始めたスタートアップで、創業当初からグローバルな組織構築を行い、今ではアジア・米国・欧州へとチームも大きく拡大しています。国内・海外ともにグローバルトップレベルの優秀なメンバーが続々と集まり、日本発グローバル企業のDAY1を創る、最高にエキサイティングなフェーズを迎えています。 解決する課題 急速に利用が拡大するSaaS・AIアプリにより、世界中のコーポレート部門は複雑な管理業務を求められる状況にあります。また、昨今のサイバーセキュリティインシデントでは、漏洩したIDを用いた攻撃がスタンダードとなっており、エンタープライズを中心により高いレベルでの対策が急務となっています。 一方で、求められる速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これはコロナ禍を経てSaaS利用が増大した背景があり、日本だけでなくグローバルで同時多発的に発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。 そこで求められるのは、AIによってアイデンティティ・SaaS・デバイスの情報を統合的に管理し、リスクを最小化しながら運用を効率化することです。ジョーシスはAI Drivenなマネジメントプラットフォームを通じて、現場のオペレーションまで一貫して支援し、企業のアイデンティティ管理におけるガバナンス向上とセキュリティリスクの最小化に寄与します。 日本発グローバル企業への挑戦 海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。 JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。 職務内容: Field Sales と協業しながら戦略的アプローチによりパイプラインの生成を行う。 電話やメール、LinkedInなどを活用しながら見込み顧客へリーチアウトする。 見込み顧客の特定と分析を行い、JOSYSのサービスについて認知向上、教育する。 能動的な傾聴スキルを活用し、顧客のニーズやビジネス上の課題を理解・発見することでJOSYSが企業へフィットするか見極める。 エンタープライズ企業の役職者との面会の機会を取得する。 オーナーシップをもちながら、日本市場におけるパイプライン生成戦略と戦術を0→1で構築する。 メッセージングやシナリオ、プレイブック作成に貢献する。 マーケティングと連携したイベントやセミナーの企画・実行 必須条件: 1年以上のSaaS、IT業界でのインサイドセールス経験 B2Bソフトウエアの営業経験 意思決定者へのへのアプローチ経験歓迎 MAツール、またはSFAの利用経験 ジョーシス掲載メディア Global展開を支える、Josysのインサイドセールス X ジョーシスサービスサイト インド「で」日本向けSaaSを開発して成功モデルに―、ラクスル松本代表に聞く 日経ビジネス 情シスに「考える業務を」 “なんでもオリジナル”の罠 JOSYS公式note

job_description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. We’re hiring a Social Content & Community Manager to join KAYAK’s North America marketing team and help transform our social presence! You’ll partner with our internal teams to create platform-native content at scale, drive engagement, and build an active community. If you know what works on social, can generate strong ideas, and execute them quickly and thoughtfully, we'd love to hear from you! This role reports to the Senior Manager, Social Strategy and is a hybrid position based in Cambridge, MA. In this role, you will: Own the social content creation process from ideation to execution, ensuring all content is anchored in our pillars and delivering against marketing objectives. Develop fresh, innovative ideas for both day-to-day content and larger social-first campaigns. Translate ideas into stories. Concept and produce content with a strong POV on which format serves which idea and channel best. Adapt KAYAK's unique brand voice and positioning to feel at home on each platform. Be a natural on camera: comfortable filming, presenting, and producing content yourself, while also knowing how to translate ideas into clear scripts and creative briefs for the wider team. Foster community: engage with followers, respond to cultural moments, and build community in a way that feels conversational and unscripted across comments, DMs, the FYP, and Reddit. Assist with monthly reporting and analytics to measure progress and optimize future content decisions. Please apply if you have: A sharp editorial instinct for transforming information and ideas into compelling content. Whether it's a product launch, a travel trend, or a company announcement, you know how to find the hook that makes it land on social. Experience in content production: You’re comfortable behind and in front of the camera, with an understanding of how to bring an idea from concept to a polished, publish-ready asset. A demonstrable track record of developing unexpected and effective content ideas that people share organically, not just content that checks a box. A strong, diverse portfolio of high performing social media work. Deeply embedded in internet culture. Fluency in culture, trends, and using social media to fuel conversation. Passionate and effective storyteller that can easily adapt ideas across social channels. Experience engaging with audiences reactively and proactively in a way that feels natural and conversational. Strong familiarity with in-app creator tools across social platforms and knowledge of video production tools (After Effects, Premiere Pro) and basic graphic design principles. There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $110,000 - $120,000.00 . We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus. Inclusion At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you. #LI-EI1

job_description: Kiss My Apps — компанія-платформа, що об’єднує 7 продуктових вертикалей та 30+ AI-first продуктів, 100+ мільйонів користувачів, власну екосистему аналітичних, пеймент та маркетингових розробок. Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей. Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо User Acquisition Manager, того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше. Коротко про роль: Ти працюватимеш із lifestyle-додатком, що вже має позитивну юніт-економіку та зараз активно масштабується. Твоя роль — не просто оптимізувати кампанії, а впливати на весь підхід до Paid Social у продукті: від стратегій закупівлі до креативних гіпотез і їх валідації разом із командою. job_description: Ми — toogeza, українська рекрутингова компанія, яка допомагає технологічним стартапам по всьому світу знаходити сильних людей і будувати команди. Зараз ми шукаємо досвідченого Юриста для одного з наших клієнтів — інвестиційної компанії, яка працює з технологічними продуктами та стартапами. Про тебе: вища юридична освіта маєш від 2 до 4 років релевантного досвіду роботи в українській або міжнародній юридичній фірмі, юридичному відділі однієї з компаній «великої четвірки» або визнаному in-house юридичному департаменті компанії працюєш з договірним правом (українським, американським та/або англійським), корпоративним правом (Україна, Кіпр, США, ЮК) маєш базове розуміння IP/авторського права та privacy (GDPR, американське законодавство про персональні дані) керуєш невеликими проєктами майже самостійно та хочеш розвиватися для керування великими напрямками роботи з мінімальним залученням досвідченіших колег маєш розвинуті аналітичні навички та вмієш розставляти пріоритети в умовах багатозадачності прокачав/-ла англійську до високого рівня: готуєш документи і ведеш усну комунікацію з контрагентами і підрядниками вільно володієш українською мовою маєш досвід використання AI-інструментів та автоматизації юридичних процесів і прагнеш їх розвивати Ти будеш: готувати перші проєкти різних типів комерційних договорів (NDA, сервісних договорів) та документів у сфері трудового права та перевіряти проєкти таких документів, підготовлені контрагентами (за українським, американським, кіпрським або англійським правом) допомагати старшим колегам, аналізуючи та вносячи правки до статутів, акціонерних угод, корпоративних резолюцій, опціонних договорів та інших документів зі сфери корпоративного права (регулюватимуться американським, англійським, кіпрським, іноді українським правом) допомагати старшим колегам із юридичним супроводом інвестицій (у тому числі венчурних), включаючи участь у due diligence процесах взаємодіяти із зовнішніми юридичними радниками під керівництвом старших колег працювати з автоматизацією процесів та contract lifecycle management робити рісьорчі та готувати висновки з різноманітних питань корпоративного, договірного, трудового та IP права, а також загальних комерційних питань допомагати старшим колегам у документах із залучення персоналу (договори, вейвери, повідомлення тощо) допомагати із питаннями Дія Сіті та бронюванням працівників забезпечувати повний цикл роботи з договорами (підготовка, погодження, підписання, зберігання) надавати юридичну підтримку, пов’язану з повсякденною роботою компанії Якщо ця роль вам відгукується — будемо раді познайомитися! Надішліть, будь ласка, своє резюме та будь-які додаткові матеріали, які вважаєте релевантними. Ми розглянемо вашу заявку протягом п’яти робочих днів і, якщо ваш досвід відповідатиме тому, що ми шукаємо, зв’яжемося з вами, щоб домовитися про дзвінок і ближче познайомитися.

job_description: O NAS Indie Campers jest globalnym liderem w podróżach typu road-trip, zarządzającym jedną z największych flot kamperów i pojazdów RV na świecie. Dzięki rosnącej obecności w Europie, Ameryce Północnej i Oceanii jesteśmy szybko skalującą się firmą, której misją jest uczynienie podróży bardziej połączonymi, wartościowymi i dostępnymi dla każdego. City Lead odgrywa kluczową rolę w realizacji tej misji lokalnie, zapewniając wysoką jakość operacji wynajmu, sprawną koordynację usług oraz spójne, zorientowane na klienta doświadczenie. Jako lider na miejscu, City Lead odpowiada za doskonałość operacyjną, wyniki zespołu oraz całościową ścieżkę klienta w danym mieście, stanowiąc pomost między globalnymi standardami a lokalnym wdrożeniem. ROLA Kierownik Oddziału nadzoruje codzienne operacje niewielkiego oddziału, samodzielnie realizując i koordynując wszystkie procesy operacyjne ze względu na mały zespół oraz brak wyspecjalizowanych działów (Serwis, Sprzedaż RV, Wsparcie). Stanowisko ma charakter w 70–80% operacyjny (hands-on) i koncentruje się na zapewnieniu płynności działań, wysokiej jakości obsługi klienta, poprawnej dokumentacji oraz gotowości floty. Ponadto Kierownik Oddziału raportuje do District Managera i odpowiada za kontrolę kosztów w oddziale, w tym efektywne wykorzystanie materiałów eksploatacyjnych, zapobieganie zbędnym wydatkom, minimalizowanie poprawek oraz zdyscyplinowane zarządzanie kosztami operacyjnymi. Kluczowe obowiązki Realizacja i koordynacja wszystkich procesów wynajmu: check-in, check-out, dokumentacja oraz aktualizacje systemowe (w tym sprzątanie i podstawowa konserwacja); Monitorowanie dziennych KPI; Promowanie produktów dodatkowych poprzez sprzedaż opartą na wartości; Wykonywanie podstawowych kontroli kamperów/vanów (akumulator, systemy wodne, gaz, oświetlenie, opony); Szybka eskalacja złożonych problemów technicznych lub mechanicznych do regionalnych zespołów serwisowych; Utrzymywanie pełnej dokładności statusu floty i jej gotowości w systemach operacyjnych; Koordynacja codziennych zmian, priorytetów i podziału zadań w małym zespole, w tym prezentowanie SOP-ów oraz wdrażanie nowych pracowników; Nadzór nad przygotowaniem i prezentacją pojazdów RV na spotkania sprzedażowe. Wymagania praktyczne Zdolność do podnoszenia lub przenoszenia lekkich i średnio ciężkich przedmiotów (10–15 kg) oraz do długotrwałego stania, chodzenia i poruszania się po terenie oddziału; Gotowość do wykonywania prac fizycznych w razie potrzeby; Komfort pracy zarówno wewnątrz, jak i na zewnątrz, w zmiennych warunkach pogodowych; Elastyczność w pracy w weekendy, święta oraz w okresach szczytowych, w celu wsparcia pilnych potrzeb operacyjnych; 2–4 lata doświadczenia w dynamicznym środowisku operacyjnym, logistyce, wynajmie, hotelarstwie lub na stanowiskach z bezpośrednim kontaktem z klientem; Silne umiejętności operacyjne i gotowość do aktywnego udziału w codziennych procesach oddziału; Umiejętność pracy wielozadaniowej, ustalania priorytetów i wykonywania zadań fizycznych w okresach dużego obciążenia; Elastyczność w pracy w wydłużonych zmianach w sezonie wysokim, zapewniająca ciągłość operacyjną; Prawo jazdy kategorii B (wymagane); Znajomość języka angielskiego (wymagana) oraz języka polskiego (mile widziana). Zobowiązanie Indie Praca w młodej, szybko rozwijającej się i innowacyjnej firmie, w której masz realny wpływ; Możliwości rozwoju kariery w Field Operations oraz przejścia do naszych biur w Lizbonie, Meksyku lub Manili; Ciągłe szkolenia i coaching, aby rozwijać umiejętności, które są dla Ciebie ważne; Pakiet wynagrodzenia obejmujący premie za wyniki i polecenia; Darmowe road tripy, dzięki którym doświadczysz podróży Indie na własnej skórze w Europie, Ameryce Północnej i Oceanii. Minimalny przedział wynagrodzenia: 80.098,00 zł brutto/rok Are you ready to Go Indie?

job_description: 职位概述 作为 3D 动作设计师（Contractor），你将加入我们的美术团队，负责为游戏角色、生物或道具制作高质量的关键帧动画（Keyframe Animation）。 我们需要一位执行力强、基本功扎实的动画师。你不需要负责复杂的动捕数据清洗或底层的动画系统搭建，但你需要能独立承担一个角色或模块的动画量产工作，确保动画在引擎中表现流畅，并符合项目的艺术风格与玩法需求。 你将与玩法策划、技术美术紧密合作，通过动画赋予角色生命力，为玩家提供极致的打击感与操作反馈。 核心职责 高质量动画制作： 根据需求文档和分镜，使用 Maya 制作高质量的 3D 角色动画（包括但不限于：待机、移动、战斗技能、受击、死亡等）。 风格化表现： 深刻理解并还原项目的艺术风格（例如：美式卡通、强打击感、夸张变形等），确保动作设计符合角色性格（Acting）。 引擎集成与调试： 将动画资源导入游戏引擎（如 Unreal/Unity 或自研引擎），配置动画混合树（Blend Trees）、状态机（State Machines）基础设置，并能够在引擎内预览和验收效果。 玩法手感打磨： 与玩法策划紧密配合，通过调整动画的节奏（Timing/Spacing）和帧数，优化游戏的操作手感和响应速度（Gameplay Feel）。 Bug修复与优化： 负责维护和修复现有动画资源中的穿插、滑步、抖动等问题，确保交付资源的稳定性。 任职要求 经验要求： 3年以上游戏行业 3D 动画制作经验，至少参与过一款完整的游戏项目开发。 专业技能： 精通 Autodesk Maya 的动画模块。 深刻理解动画 12项基本法则（如挤压拉伸、预备动作、跟随动作等），尤其是在人体力学（Body Mechanics）和重量感表现上有扎实功底。 擅长 纯手K（Keyframe） 动画制作，能够处理风格化（Stylized）的角色动态。 沟通与协作： 具备良好的沟通能力，能够准确理解反馈意见并快速迭代。 能够主动与上下游（策划/模型/特效）对齐需求，预判潜在的制作风险。 作品集： 必须提供 Demo Reel，展示涵盖肢体运动、战斗动作和表演片段的高质量作品。 加分项 引擎经验： 熟悉 Unreal Engine 或 Unity 的动画蓝图/系统。 技术理解： 了解基础的绑定（Rigging）知识，能进行简单的蒙皮（Skinning）修复或给 TA 提供有效的绑定反馈。 多风格适应： 既能驾驭写实风格，也能处理夸张卡通风格。 用工性质：与专业人事服务公司FESCO Adecco签订劳动合同.

job_description: 关于我们 我们以玩家体验为核心，致力于用创新技术为全球玩家带来卓越的游戏体验。作为 Riot 中国在研项目组的一员，你将与客户端、引擎、美术及策划等多元团队紧密合作，围绕 UE5 前沿能力进行研究与工程化落地，打造高品质、稳定高效的内容生产管线。我们鼓励开放协作与持续学习，期待热爱技术与艺术融合的你加入！ 作为一名资深技术美术师，你将加入拳头未发布的R&D项目团队（Base：广州），共同打造一款充满潜力的新游戏。 你将与美术、程序和制作团队紧密合作，探索并定义UE5在移动端的极限表现，为项目建立高效、稳定、可扩展的美术生产管线。我们希望你不仅能在渲染、性能与工具开发上提供深度技术支持，也能以创造性的方式解决跨学科问题，让美术愿景真正落地。作为团队中的核心推动者，你将通过优化流程、指导团队、推动标准化，为项目打造出兼具美感与性能的游戏体验。 岗位职责 技术方向与选型 研究评估 UE5 关键特性（Nanite/Lumen/Substrate、World Partition/HLOD、Niagara、Chaos、PCG/Mass 等），结合移动端与美术、程序团队共同制定技术方向与选型。 落地符合大型多人手游与 LOL 风格的渲染与表现方案，兼顾大规模单位、战场的平衡效果，成本与性能。 标准与规范 制定并维护项目级美术资产规范，确保流程工具与资产的健康管理。 管线与工具 规划端到端资产生产管线，开发流程插件，打通 CI/CD 与版本管理（Perforce/Git LFS）。 构建材质/着色器预设库、LOD/碰撞批处理、贴图压缩与打包模板，提升生产效率。 性能与度量 与技术团队共同定义移动端 KPI（帧率、内存、包体等），使用 UnrealInsights/Profiler/RenderDoc 定位瓶颈并推动优化闭环。 与客户端协作资源流与异步加载策略，支撑大地图与大规模单位战场的稳定表现。 团队建设与管理 组建与管理 TA 团队，进行目标设定、绩效评估、能力培养与人才梯队建设。 与招聘/美术领导层协作学科规划、资源配置与外包技术把控（技术包、交付与验收）。 跨团队协作与治理 作为艺术与工程的桥梁，推动 SOP、评审机制与风险治理落地；与 IT/平台/安全等技术组织对齐环境与发布流程。 沉淀共享标准、工具与知识库，并与工作室其他 TA 主管保持一致性。 任职要求 8年以上实时内容/游戏开发经验，含5年以上技术美术经验；有移动端与跨平台项目经历，至少参与 1–2 个里程碑或上线项目。 深入理解 3D 数学与计算机图形学，熟悉实时渲染、PBR 与移动端适配取舍。 精通 UE4/UE5（UE5优先）生产流程与工具链，熟练使用 Maya；具备脚本与着色器能力（Python、Blueprint，熟悉 HLSL/Shader 优化）。 具备系统化的标准化与工程化能力：能从规范，→管线，→工具，→度量建立闭环，并在团队内推进执行。 有移动端性能优化实战：帧时间分解、内存/纹理池治理、包体控制、Shader 变体与 Cook 时间优化。 优秀的沟通与推动力，能在质量与性能之间做权衡并形成团队共识；重视文档化与知识沉淀。 普通话流利，能阅读与编写英文技术文档。 加分项 具备大型MMO，大规模单位或开放世界项目经验，熟悉大规模场景分区、流式加载与资源分层 Houdini/PCG 程序化生产经验，能落地生成工具与关卡布置流程。 外包技术管理经验（技术包、质量标准与验收流程）。 对英雄联盟美术风格有理解，具备国际化协作经验。 作品集与材料 请在作品集中包含 2–3 个具有代表性的项目案例，展示你在技术美术流程中的思考与解决方案（如性能优化前后对比、制作流程改进或工具应用等）。 欢迎附上个人编写的工具或脚本示例（可为自制或开源内容），并简单说明使用目的与思路。 若有，可分享你主导或参与制定的技术规范或流程的概要示例（例如命名规范、贴图管理流程、LOD/碰撞设置思路等）， 无需提供任何公司或项目的敏感信息 。

job_description: Retina Vitreous Associates is a busy, well established group of ophthalmologists, complemented by a staff of eye care professionals to provide multi-specialty services to the greater Hampton Roads area and surrounding communities. We are expanding our Team and are searching for a fellowship trained Retina Specialist, with exceptional surgical skills and the talent to develop and maintain excellent relationships with our referring physicians, as well as functioning comfortably with clinical and surgical demand. We have immediate patient volumes combined with an established referral base to create an exceptional opportunity. Retina Vitreous Associates is part of CVP Physicians — a premier eye care network positioned for market and thought leadership in the industry. The role offers the opportunity to become part of a rapidly growing team operating in all major ophthalmology subspecialties around a single vision for transformative eye care. We foster an innovative work environment that encourages research and education while leveraging the latest technologies to deliver next-generation patient care. This is a shareholder track position with a competitive base and bonus opportunity, generous benefit package, enviable call schedule, in a family friendly community with an excellent standard of living. The greater Toledo area is located at the mouth of the Maumee River and Lake Erie. This community features top ranked schools, both public and private, award winning Metro parks, and a wide variety of cultural activities. Known as “The Glass City,” Toledo is world headquarters to Libbey Glass and Owens Corning, who sponsors an LPGA tournament locally each year. The Toledo Art Museum houses over 30,000 objects of Art including major collections of glass art, as well as classrooms for the Art Department at the University of Toledo. The Toledo Symphony and the Toledo Ballet perform at the Stranahan Theatre, which also hosts a traveling series of Broadway performances. The Toledo Zoo is nestled along the banks of the Maumee River, home to a wide variety of animals as well as a Sunday evening concert series in the summer months. The Toledo Mud Hens baseball team and the Toledo Walleyes hockey team are also at home here. For more information , contact Rachel Tankersley at racheltankersley@eyecare-partners.com.

job_description: The Role… At Soho House, a Pastry Chef leads the pastry section and delivering exceptional desserts, cakes, baked goods, and other sweet offerings that elevate the overall dining experience for our members and guests. Y our main responsibility is to bring creativity, precision, and a strong technical background to the role, ensuring that every item meets our high standards of taste, texture, and appearance. From fine patisserie to rustic breads, the Pastry Chef ensures the pastry offering is always seasonal, refined, and aligned with the club’s culinary philosophy. What's in it for you? Weekly Pay Team meal whilst on shift prepared by our chefs Soho Friends Membership 50% Team discount on Food & Drink, 7 days a week Staff Room Rates Health Cash Plan (option to up to 2 additional dependents) Dental Plan (option to add up to 2 additional dependents) Birthday Day Off after 1 years' continuous service Up to 50% Staff Discount on Cowshed & Soho Home In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 2 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice. Free Counselling Sessions Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & Tonic Programmes offer unique food and drink training, events and opportunities to inspire and educate. Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionally Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to. Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career Key duties… Lead the day-to-day operations of the pastry section, ensuring smooth service and consistent quality. Prepare and produce a wide range of baked goods, desserts, and patisserie, from scratch and to a high standard. Develop new dessert and pastry menu items in collaboration with the Executive and Head Chef, aligning with seasonal themes and member preferences. Maintain excellent presentation and consistency in all pastry items served, whether plated, buffet-style, or takeaway. Assist in the training and mentoring of Commis Chefs and Demi Chefs de Partie, helping to develop their technical skills and kitchen knowledge. Attending regular meetings with front and back of house teams to learn about any menu or service changes and specials alongside daily tastings. Assist in preparation of team meals as requested, considering dietary needs and variety. Demonstrate a proactive attitude towards learning, improvement, and teamwork. Supporting with the deep cleaning of the entire kitchen before close. Wrapping unused items and storing them in proper area at the end of service. What we are looking for... A successful Pastry Chef for Soho House will ideally have up to 2 years’ experience in a busy high-profile venue and a natural flair for first class service. You’ll be reliable, friendly and happy to be a key part of the team that strives for success. Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in similar capacity Passion for food, attention to detail, and a strong desire to learn and grow. Understanding of basic food safety and hygiene practices. Good communication and teamwork skills. Positive, proactive, and respectful attitude in a busy kitchen environment. Culinary qualification (e.g., NVQ Level 1 or 2) is a plus but not essential. Must be able to demonstrate competency as outlined in the training schedule and Club School Must be able to work flexible shifts and schedules, including weekends and holidays as needed Ability to take direction, work in a team environment and autonomously The salary range for this role if filled within the UK is listed below. The range for the position in different geographies may vary based on market differences. Pay Range £17.50 — £17.50 GBP

job_description: 【プロジェクト紹介】 グローバルパイロットプログラム（Global Pilot Program）は、TALグループ（好未来教育集団）が海外事業（Think Academy）向けに、将来の校長およびコア人材を育成するために設計したエリートプログラムです。ここでは、世界のK12教育業界に深く関わり、最先端の教育理念と技術に触れ、自身の潜在能力を最大限に引き出し、豊富な実践経験を積むことができます。 【職務内容】 業務ニーズに基づき、顧客調査を行い、顧客のニーズと課題を理解し、マーケティングパートナーと協力して顧客チャネルを開拓し、トラフィックを増加させる。 合理的な募集計画を策定し、異なるタイミングに応じたターゲットを絞ったイベントや募集ツールを設計する。分校の募集活動の企画、実行、振り返りを推進し、募集結果に責任を持つ。 効率的な運営SOPプロセスを構築し、プロセスのキーポイントを把握し、経験をまとめ、継続的に改善する。 担当する製品ラインにおける1対1診断授業、短期クラス授業、長期クラス授業、指導と質問対応、保護者サービスなどを担当する。 【こんなあなたを歓迎します】 2024年、2025年卒業予定の学部生/大学院生、専門は問わず、海外関連のバックグラウンドを持つ方を優先します。 日本語が流暢で、授業言語として使用可能。中国語で簡単なコミュニケーションが取れると尚可。 教育業界を愛し、子供が好きで、授業に情熱を持っている。 優れたコミュニケーション能力とチームワーク能力を持つ。 強い知的好奇心、優れた学習能力と学習に対する鋭敏さを持つ。 広い視野を持ち、楽観的でタフな性格、自発性、創造性、0から1を生み出す冒険心を持つ。 【育成と発展】 専門的で体系的な育成、ベテラン講師によるキャリアパスのリード 効率的で迅速な昇進ルート、優秀なパートナーには異動の機会を提供 完全な数学授業トレーニングを受け、海外ユーザー向けのS級講師になる 3年でグローバル業務のコア人材に、5年で海外業務の校長（マネージャーレベル）になる 【成長の機会】 テクノロジー＋教育で私たちは成長するThink Academyは、TALグループ（好未来教育集団）傘下の学而思の海外ブランドです。好未来は教育業界で高い評価と影響力を持ち、教育業界のリーダーとして20年の技術と経験を蓄積してきました。Think Academyに参加することは、グローバル業務の一員となり、最先端で実用的な知識とスキルを学ぶことを意味します。 文化＋雰囲気が成長を加速するThink Academyは、好未来の重要な戦略的業務として、グローバル業務を開拓する際に、包容力、実務的、革新的な多様な企業文化を持ち、0から1を生み出すスタートアップ精神の下、若くて共通の信念を持つ仲間を集め、ミッション駆動、責任感、オープンで正直、全力を尽くすことを推進します。 人材の安心保障を享受する競争力のある給与水準社会保険と住宅積立金を全額支給＋商業保険、豊富な福利厚生企業大学が提供する豊富なキャリア開発コース、専門および管理コースを通じて、従業員の生涯成長を支援します。

job_description: 【프로젝트 소개】 글로벌 파일럿 프로그램(Global Pilot Program)은 탈레듀 그룹(TAL)이 해외 사업(Think Academy)을 위해 차세대 교장 및 핵심 인재를 양성하기 위해 특별히 설계한 엘리트 프로그램입니다. 이 프로그램을 통해 글로벌 K12 교육 산업에 깊이 참여하며 최첨단 교육 이념과 기술을 접하고, 자신의 잠재력을 극대화할 수 있는 풍부한 실무 경험을 얻을 수 있습니다. 【직무 내용】 비즈니스 요구에 따라 고객 조사를 진행하고, 고객의 니즈와 문제점을 파악하며, 마케팅 파트너와 협력하여 고객 채널을 개척하고 유입량을 증가시킵니다. 합리적인 학생 모집 계획을 수립하고, 다양한 시점에 맞춰 목표 지향적인 활동 및 모집 도구를 설계합니다. 지점별 학생 모집 활동의 기획, 실행 및 복기를 주도하며, 모집 결과에 대한 책임을 집니다. 효율적인 운영 SOP 프로세스를 구축하고, 프로세스의 핵심 포인트를 파악하여 지속적으로 경험을 정리하고 개선합니다. 담당 제품 라인의 1:1 진단 수업, 단기 클래스, 장기 클래스 강의, 학습 상담 및 학부모 서비스 등을 책임집니다. 【이런 분을 환영합니다】 24, 25학번 졸업 예정인 학사/석사 신입생으로, 전공 무관하며 해외 관련 경험이 있는 분을 우대합니다. 한국어 회화가 유창하며, 강의 언어로 사용 가능하고, 중국어로 일상 소통이 가능해야 합니다. 교육 업계에 대한 열정이 있으며, 아이들을 좋아하고 강의에 대한 열의가 있는 분. 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 능력과 팀워크 역량을 갖춘 분. 강한 호기심과 탁월한 학습 능력 및 학습 민감도를 가진 분. 넓은 시야를 가지고 있으며, 낙관적이고 끈기 있으며, 자기 주도력과 창의력, 0-1의 도전 정신을 갖춘 분. 【양성 및 발전】 전문적이고 체계적인 양성 프로그램, 베테랑 멘토의 커리어 가이드 제공. 빠르고 효율적인 승진 경로, 우수한 인재에게는 로테이션 기회 제공. 완전한 수학 강의 교육을 통해 해외 사용자를 대상으로 강의할 수 있는 S급 명사수가 됩니다. 3년 내 글로벌 비즈니스 핵심 인재로, 5년 내 해외 사업 교장(매니저급)으로 성장할 수 있습니다. 【성장과 수확】 기술 + 교육으로 성장Think Academy는 탈레듀 그룹의 해외 브랜드로, 탈레듀는 교육 업계에서 탁월한 명성과 영향력을 가진 리더이며, 20년의 기술과 경험을 보유하고 있습니다. Think Academy에 합류하면 글로벌 비즈니스의 일원이 되어 최첨단의 실용적인 지식과 기술을 배울 수 있습니다. 문화 + 분위기로 빠른 성장Think Academy는 탈레듀의 중요한 전략적 사업으로, 글로벌 비즈니스를 개척하며 포용적이고 실용적이며 혁신적인 다원화된 기업 문화를 가지고 있습니다. 0-1의 스타트업 정신을 바탕으로 젊고 공통된 신념을 가진 동료들을 모아, 사명감으로 이끌며 책임감 있고 솔직하며 전력을 다하는 환경을 제공합니다. 인재 복지 보장경쟁력 있는 급여 수준;5보험 1금 완전 납부 + 상업 보험, 다양한 복리후생 제공;기업 대학을 통해 풍부한 직업 개발 과정, 전문 및 관리 과정을 제공하여 직원의 평생 성장을 지원합니다.

Türkiye’deki dinamik ekibimizin bir parçası olabilir ve eğitimin geleceğini aktif şekilde şekillendirebilirsin! GoStudent’ta Global Müşteri Hizmetleri Yöneticisi olarak, her öğrencinin başarıya ulaşması için ihtiyaç duyduğu desteği sağlamada kilit bir rol üstleniyorsun. Eğitimi dönüştürmek ve öğrencilerin hayatında kalıcı bir etki yaratmak isteyen tutkulu bir ekiple birlikte çalışma fırsatın var. Konum İstanbul (hibrit) veya Türkiye genelinde (remote) Misyonumuzdaki Rolün: Müşteri Desteği – Müşterilere canlı sohbet, e-posta ve telefon aracılığıyla destek veriyorsun. Ağırlıklı olarak Almanca’ya ihtiyaç duyacaksın ama DACH bölgesinin yanı sıra İspanya, İtalya, Fransa, Polonya ve Hollanda gibi pazarlarda çeviri araçlarını da kullanacaksın. Takım Çalışması – Farklı pazarlar için müşteri odaklı çözümler geliştirmek üzere ekibinle yakın çalışıyorsun. Organizasyon & Problem Çözme – Ders planlamalarını koordine ediyor, öğretmen aramalarını, rezervasyonları ve tüm bölgelerden gelen acil talepleri yönetiyorsun. Ara Yüz – Müşteri hizmetleri ekibi ile eğitmen ağımız arasında köprü görevi görerek süreçlerin sorunsuz işlemesini sağlıyorsun. Neler Getiriyorsun? Müşteri Hizmetleri Deneyimi (2–5 yıl) – Tercihen daha önce müşteri desteği veya çağrı merkezi tecrüben var, hizmet süreçlerine hakimsin. Çok iyi Almanca bilgisi (C1/C2) – Almanca konuşan müşterilerle rahatça iletişim kurabiliyorsun. İngilizce, İtalyanca, İspanyolca, Fransızca, Lehçe ya da Yunanca gibi ek diller (en az B2) ise büyük bir artı. Araç Kullanım Yetkinliği – CRM sistemleri ve çeviri araçlarını etkin şekilde kullanabiliyor, yeni yazılımlara kolayca adapte olabiliyorsun. İletişim Becerisi & Müşteri Odaklılık – Müşteri ihtiyaçlarını hızla anlıyor, empatiyle yaklaşıyor, net iletişim kurup her zaman uygun çözümü buluyorsun. Düzen & İnisiyatif – Planlı çalışıyor, sorumluluk alıyor ve yoğun zamanlarda bile soğukkanlılığını koruyorsun. 💡 Geleceğin: Bu rol, müşteri başarısı ve sürdürülebilir memnuniyet dünyasına açılan bir sıçrama tahtası. Katkıların, müşteri deneyimimizi şekillendirmede büyük rol oynayacak. Potansiyelini Ortaya Çıkarman İçin Yaklaşımımız Birlikte Büyüyoruz – Gelişim Programımızla kariyerine yön ver. LinkedIn Learning’de binlerce kursa, Mentorluk Programına ve aylık öğrenme oturumlarına erişimin olacak. Ayrıca seni GoStudent deneyimiyle tanıştırmak için ilk günden 30 saatlik ücretsiz birebir dersin hazır. Toplulukla Güçlen – GoStudent Kaynak Gruplarımızdan birine katılarak kendini ifade edebileceğin alanlar yarat. Üst Düzey Ekipman – İlk günden itibaren ihtiyacın olan teknik ekipmanları sana sağlıyoruz. Açıklığa ve Çeşitliliğe Bağlılığımız Benzersiz becerilerini ve tutkunun değerini biliyoruz. Yaşın, cinsiyetin, milliyetin ya da siyasi görüşün değil – yeteneğin ve motivasyonun bizim için önemli. Tek boynuzlu bir at bile olsan, yeter ki pozitif bir etki yaratabileceğine inan! Tüm şartları karşılamasan bile, kendine güveniyorsan başvur. Çünkü çeşitlilik bizi daha yaratıcı, yenilikçi ve güçlü kılıyor. Hazırsan Başvur! Eğitimi bizimle birlikte yeniden düşünmeye, hırslı bir ekibin parçası olmaya ve gerçek bir etki yaratmaya hazırsan hemen başvur! 🚀 📌 Lütfen özgeçmişini PDF formatında ve tercihen İngilizce olarak yükle—çünkü DOC formatı sistemimizde desteklenmeyebilir. job_description: O NAS Indie Campers jest globalnym liderem w podróżach typu road-trip, zarządzającym jedną z największych flot kamperów i pojazdów RV na świecie. Dzięki rosnącej obecności w Europie, Ameryce Północnej i Oceanii jesteśmy szybko skalującą się firmą, której misją jest uczynienie podróży bardziej połączonymi, wartościowymi i dostępnymi dla każdego. City Lead odgrywa kluczową rolę w realizacji tej misji lokalnie, zapewniając wysoką jakość operacji wynajmu, sprawną koordynację usług oraz spójne, zorientowane na klienta doświadczenie. Jako lider na miejscu, City Lead odpowiada za doskonałość operacyjną, wyniki zespołu oraz całościową ścieżkę klienta w danym mieście, stanowiąc pomost między globalnymi standardami a lokalnym wdrożeniem. ROLA City Lead nadzoruje codzienne operacje niewielkiego oddziału, samodzielnie realizując i koordynując wszystkie procesy operacyjne ze względu na mały zespół oraz brak wyspecjalizowanych działów (Serwis, Sprzedaż RV, Wsparcie). Stanowisko ma charakter w 70–80% operacyjny (hands-on) i koncentruje się na zapewnieniu płynności działań, wysokiej jakości obsługi klienta, poprawnej dokumentacji oraz gotowości floty. Ponadto Junior City Lead raportuje do District Managera i odpowiada za kontrolę kosztów w oddziale, w tym efektywne wykorzystanie materiałów eksploatacyjnych, zapobieganie zbędnym wydatkom, minimalizowanie poprawek oraz zdyscyplinowane zarządzanie kosztami operacyjnymi. Kluczowe obowiązki Realizacja i koordynacja wszystkich procesów wynajmu: check-in, check-out, dokumentacja oraz aktualizacje systemowe (w tym sprzątanie i podstawowa konserwacja); Monitorowanie dziennych KPI; Promowanie produktów dodatkowych poprzez sprzedaż opartą na wartości; Wykonywanie podstawowych kontroli kamperów/vanów (akumulator, systemy wodne, gaz, oświetlenie, opony); Szybka eskalacja złożonych problemów technicznych lub mechanicznych do regionalnych zespołów serwisowych; Utrzymywanie pełnej dokładności statusu floty i jej gotowości w systemach operacyjnych; Koordynacja codziennych zmian, priorytetów i podziału zadań w małym zespole, w tym prezentowanie SOP-ów oraz wdrażanie nowych pracowników; Nadzór nad przygotowaniem i prezentacją pojazdów RV na spotkania sprzedażowe. Wymagania praktyczne Zdolność do podnoszenia lub przenoszenia lekkich i średnio ciężkich przedmiotów (10–15 kg) oraz do długotrwałego stania, chodzenia i poruszania się po terenie oddziału; Gotowość do wykonywania prac fizycznych w razie potrzeby; Komfort pracy zarówno wewnątrz, jak i na zewnątrz, w zmiennych warunkach pogodowych; Elastyczność w pracy w weekendy, święta oraz w okresach szczytowych, w celu wsparcia pilnych potrzeb operacyjnych; 2–4 lata doświadczenia w dynamicznym środowisku operacyjnym, logistyce, wynajmie, hotelarstwie lub na stanowiskach z bezpośrednim kontaktem z klientem; Silne umiejętności operacyjne i gotowość do aktywnego udziału w codziennych procesach oddziału; Umiejętność pracy wielozadaniowej, ustalania priorytetów i wykonywania zadań fizycznych w okresach dużego obciążenia; Elastyczność w pracy w wydłużonych zmianach w sezonie wysokim, zapewniająca ciągłość operacyjną; Prawo jazdy kategorii B (wymagane); Znajomość języka angielskiego (wymagana) oraz języka polskiego (mile widziana). Zobowiązanie Indie Praca w młodej, szybko rozwijającej się i innowacyjnej firmie, w której masz realny wpływ; Możliwości rozwoju kariery w Field Operations oraz przejścia do naszych biur w Lizbonie, Meksyku lub Manili; Ciągłe szkolenia i coaching, aby rozwijać umiejętności, które są dla Ciebie ważne; Pakiet wynagrodzenia obejmujący premie za wyniki i polecenia; Darmowe road tripy, dzięki którym doświadczysz podróży Indie na własnej skórze w Europie, Ameryce Północnej i Oceanii. job_description: The Role… At Soho House, a Pastry Chef leads the pastry section and delivering exceptional desserts, baked goods, and other sweet offerings that elevate the overall dining experience for our members and guests. Y our main responsibility is to bring creativity, precision, and a strong technical background to the role, ensuring that every item meets our high standards of taste, texture, and appearance. From fine patisserie to rustic breads and indulgent plated desserts, the Pastry Chef ensures the pastry offering is always seasonal, refined, and aligned with the club’s culinary philosophy. What's in it for you? Weekly Pay Team meal whilst on shift prepared by our chefs Soho Friends Membership 50% Team discount on Food & Drink, 7 days a week Staff Room Rates Health Cash Plan (option to up to 2 additional dependents) Dental Plan (option to add up to 2 additional dependents) Birthday Day Off after 1 years' continuous service Up to 50% Staff Discount on Cowshed & Soho Home In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 2 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice. Free Counselling Sessions Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & Tonic Programmes offer unique food and drink training, events and opportunities to inspire and educate. Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionally Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to. Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career Key duties… Lead the day-to-day operations of the pastry section, ensuring smooth service and consistent quality. Prepare and produce a wide range of baked goods, desserts, and patisserie, from scratch and to a high standard. Develop new dessert and pastry menu items in collaboration with the Executive and Head Chef, aligning with seasonal themes and member preferences. Maintain excellent presentation and consistency in all pastry items served, whether plated, buffet-style, or takeaway. Assist in the training and mentoring of Commis Chefs and Demi Chefs de Partie, helping to develop their technical skills and kitchen knowledge. Attending regular meetings with front and back of house teams to learn about any menu or service changes and specials alongside daily tastings. Assist in preparation of team meals as requested, considering dietary needs and variety. Demonstrate a proactive attitude towards learning, improvement, and teamwork. Supporting with the deep cleaning of the entire kitchen before close. Wrapping unused items and storing them in proper area at the end of service. What we are looking for... A successful Pastry Chef for Soho House will ideally have up to 2 years’ experience in a busy high-profile venue and a natural flair for first class service. You’ll be reliable, friendly and happy to be a key part of the team that strives for success. Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in similar capacity Passion for food, attention to detail, and a strong desire to learn and grow. Understanding of basic food safety and hygiene practices. Good communication and teamwork skills. Positive, proactive, and respectful attitude in a busy kitchen environment. Culinary qualification (e.g., NVQ Level 1 or 2) is a plus but not essential. Must be able to demonstrate competency as outlined in the training schedule and Club School Must be able to work flexible shifts and schedules, including weekends and holidays as needed Ability to take direction, work in a team environment and autonomously The salary range for this role if filled within the UK is listed below. job_description: We are at the beginning of a global energy transformation of a scale not seen in generations. A future low-cost, low-carbon electric grid, serving a world that electrifies everything, is within our reach. The last remaining gap is breaking the link between electricity supply and demand. The lowest-cost, most sustainable sources of energy today come from intermittent renewable generation; but our homes, businesses and industries need electricity at the flick of a switch. That gap can be closed by energy storage: Devices that store electricity when it is plentiful, then provide power back to the grid when it is needed. Solutions, including ones using lithium-ion batteries, are being deployed in massive numbers to start filling this gap. But so far, none of those solutions have proven the ability to deliver power any time, anywhere, over decades of service: The level of reliability we’ve come to expect, and that the future grid will need. This is the biggest challenge in energy today. Invinity is at the forefront of finding a solution. And we need you to help us deliver it. Developed, manufactured and delivered by our teams in Canada and the UK, Invinity’s vanadium flow batteries (or “VFBs”) can be installed anywhere and consistently deliver electricity as needed over a service life exceeding 30 years. Moreover, Invinity’s VFBs are highly recyclable, don’t rely on rare or conflict minerals, and won’t catch fire. Invinity is a global VFB leader, with over 190 megawatt-hours of its batteries operational or in construction for over 82 projects across 15 countries - more than any other emerging energy storage provider. We’ve deployed the largest flow battery systems in the U.S., Canada, Australia, and the UK. Along the way we’ve earned financial support from the UK Infrastructure Bank, the U.S. Department of Energy, and some of the world’s leading institutional investors.
